title: चम्पा
description: Devkota's Nepali social novel, presented in chapters (अध्याय). The novel survived only in manuscript — titled merely 'नेपाली सामाजिक उपन्यास' — and साझा प्रकाशन named it 'चम्पा' after its heroine when publishing it posthumously. A scan of the साझा print edition (digitized by OLE Nepal / pustakalaya.org) is bundled here as a download.

rights.basis: Author died 1959; Nepal's Copyright Act 2059 grants life + 50 years, expiring 2009.
